description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter, which handles conversion between different CSS length units such as px, pt, mm, cm, and in, including internal precision handling and conversion logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter
classes.description: A class for converting between different CSS length units, managing internal and output precision, and performing unit conversions with support for arbitrary precision calculations.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length object from one unit to another, maintaining significant figures and handling conversions across measurement systems.

methods.name: getSigFigs
methods.description: Calculates the number of significant figures in a decimal number represented as a string.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Multiplies two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Divides two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of significant figures, using arbitrary precision if available.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales a floating-point number to a specified number of decimal places, handling negative scales.
